svg.title: Figure DT-3. Doubles air lines and shut-off valve positions
svg.desc: A tractor pulling two trailers with a red emergency line and a blue service line running to the back. Valve at the rear of the front trailer labeled OPEN; valve at the rear of the last trailer labeled CLOSED; dolly tank drain labeled CLOSED.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • Air-flow check: tractor parking brake on and/or wheels chocked, normal pressure, push in the red trailer air supply knob, apply the trailer hand brake.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • At the rear of the last trailer, open the emergency line valve: you should hear air. Close it. Do the same with the service line.

text.font-family: Liberation Sans, DejaVu Sans, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: • No air? Check that the shut-off valves on the trailers and dolly are OPEN. You must have air all the way to the back.
